installation.description: The installation whose parameters are re-written.

key.description: The key the parameters are re-written under, as the document names it (an alias).

phase.description: started: kept before the first write; completed: kept after the last one.

considered.description: How many SecureString parameters the root holds.

planned.description: How many of them the run re-writes.

rekeyed.description: How many were re-written so far (completed) or none (started).

deferred.description: How many were left because they changed within secrets.grace.

names.description: The names of the parameters to re-write. Names only, never a value.
